position_source: JPL DE440s kernel; Star Almanack shadow geometry
status: PROVISIONAL — geometry and times not independently validated

visibility_reference.credit: Eclipse Predictions by Fred Espenak, NASA/GSFC

visibility: Visible from the eastern Pacific, the Americas, Europe, and Africa wherever the Moon is above the horizon during the eclipse.
observing_note: Safe to view directly. Binoculars or a small telescope make the umbral boundary easier to follow across the lunar surface.
